content.value_statement: WhatsApp delivery failures can be hard to trace across messages, webhooks, and API logs. This skill provides operational checklists and command patterns for focused Kapso diagnostics.
actual_capabilities: Lists the environment variables needed for Kapso API access.
Provides command patterns for listing and inspecting WhatsApp messages.
Includes workflows for webhook delivery and API log triage.
Shows health check commands for project and phone number status.
Links to message debugging, triage, and health reference guides.
limitations: The reviewed package contains only SKILL.md; referenced scripts were not included in the audited file set.
Commands require valid Kapso API configuration before they can return results.
It does not create or update WhatsApp webhook settings.
It depends on user authorization for any production message or log data.

use_cases.title: Investigate Failed Deliveries
use_cases.description: Trace a reported delivery issue from message lists to message details and conversation lookup.

use_cases.title: Review Webhook Retries
use_cases.description: Check webhook delivery attempts and related API logs during an integration incident.

use_cases.title: Run Health Checks
use_cases.description: Verify project overview and phone number health before escalating a WhatsApp incident.

prompt_templates.title: Check Phone Number Health
prompt_templates.prompt: Use observe-whatsapp to check health for phone number ID <id>. Summarize status, errors, and next actions.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect Message Delivery
prompt_templates.prompt: Investigate message ID <id> with observe-whatsapp. Include delivery state, related conversation, and likely failure causes.

prompt_templates.title: Triage Webhook Failures
prompt_templates.prompt: Use observe-whatsapp to review webhook deliveries and API logs for <time window>. Identify retry patterns and failed endpoints.

prompt_templates.title: Correlate Incident Evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: Use observe-whatsapp to build an incident timeline for phone number ID <id>, message ID <id>, and webhook failures in <time window>.

output_examples.input: A support engineer reports that a WhatsApp message did not arrive.
output: Message status reviewed with the provided message ID.
Conversation context checked for related delivery events.
Likely failure cause and next action summarized for escalation.

output_examples.input: A webhook endpoint is returning intermittent failures.
output: Webhook delivery attempts grouped by status and time window.
Recent API log errors compared with delivery retries.
Endpoint behavior summarized with recommended owner follow-up.

output_examples.input: An operations lead wants a WhatsApp health review before launch.
output: Project overview and phone number health checked.
Configuration warnings listed with severity and owner.
Launch readiness summarized in plain language.

best_practices: Use least-privilege API keys and rotate them after incident response work.
Confirm user authorization before inspecting message, conversation, or webhook data.
Record findings with message IDs, phone number IDs, timestamps, and clear next actions.
anti_patterns: Do not run diagnostics against production data without approval.
Do not paste API keys or message contents into shared prompts or tickets.
Do not assume webhook failures are message failures without checking both data sources.

faq.question: What does this skill help troubleshoot?
faq.answer: It helps investigate WhatsApp message delivery, webhook retries, API errors, and phone number health in Kapso.

faq.question: Does it send WhatsApp messages?
faq.answer: No. The skill is focused on observation, diagnostics, and triage workflows.

faq.question: What setup is required?
faq.answer: The skill documents KAPSO_API_BASE_URL and KAPSO_API_KEY as required environment variables.

faq.question: Can it inspect production message data?
faq.answer: Yes, if the configured API key has access. Users should confirm authorization and redact sensitive data.

faq.question: Are the referenced scripts included in this audit?
faq.answer: No. The audited package contains only SKILL.md, so script behavior was not reviewed.

faq.question: Does it manage webhook configuration?
faq.answer: No. The skill points users to integrate-whatsapp for webhook setup and changes.
